historical_references.reference: Ibn Faizel al-Balkhi (950-1019 AD): A prominent Persian scholar and polymath who contributed significantly to various fields such as mathematics, astronomy, philosophy, and theology. He is best known for his work on the determination of the circumference of the Earth based on the measurement of the Earth's shadow during a lunar eclipse.

Shaykh al-Faizel bin 'Abd al-Qadir al-Jilani (1077-1166 AD): A prominent Sufi saint and scholar known for his spiritual teachings and influence on the development of the Qadiriya Sufi order. He is also known for his numerous miracles and his role in the spread of Sufism throughout the Islamic world.
